works.excerpt: Mindgut Skin Worlds Skin worlds / V07 / proposed Window 4 of 7 A skin changes how Mindgut looks. Never what it does. Seven ways of knowing, each taken from a working practice and run on the same record. Send a line below: a stand-in answers for Mir, the line is coded word by word, and every world redraws with it. Each world then shows the app itself in that skin, with its system sheet. Send ↵ Ring screen A you, centered on the core Ring screen B Mir, centered where you point Lattice and fringes their product; the pitch difference is the clash R
